primary_sources.title: Newman 1964
primary_sources.read_scope: Product rational approximation to absolute value; original p(x),r(x) construction. Classical root-exponential motif is prior work.

primary_sources.title: Gough-Zhang arXiv:1311.1375v2
primary_sources.read_scope: Section 3.1 equations 3.1-3.2, passive drift A=-C^dagger C/2-i Omega; realization machinery is established.

primary_sources.title: Huang-Park-Chan-Lin arXiv:2506.10308v2
primary_sources.read_scope: Equations 2-8 and Theorem 1; CP coupled modes, conditional feasibility, SDP and frequency-domain realization. Strongest same-question comparator.

primary_sources.title: Huang et al arXiv:2603.25708v1
primary_sources.read_scope: Setup equations 1-3; Assumption 1, Theorem 1 and Corollary 2; conclusion explicitly leaves physical coupled-Lindblad constraints as a further complexity question.

primary_sources.title: Kessing et al arXiv:2608.02517v1
primary_sources.read_scope: Sections 1.3 and 2, frequency-dependent temperature and weak detailed balance; do not infer strong-coupling thermalization from a few rates.

primary_sources.title: Chen-Cai arXiv:2610.29372v1
primary_sources.read_scope: Sections 3-5, finite-rank physical Gaussian bath and explicitly paid occupation cutoff/dilution and circuits. Competing whole-kernel positive mechanism.
